title: Drip Wild Berries 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Wild Berries from Drip E-liquid offers a delightful blend of diverse berry flavours. Each puff of this e-liquid brings forth a burst of naturally sweet and tangy notes from a medley of wild berries, providing a rich, refreshing vape that fruit lovers will relish. Shortfill bottles from Drip E-liquids present the ideal way to personalise your nicotine levels. Each bottle comes loaded with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an extra 20ml space for a duo of nicotine shots, granting you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply introduce 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, shake well, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer longevity for your beloved e-liquids but are also an economical and handy option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in Shortfills. Drip E-liquids are a prime choice for extraordinary shortfill e-liquids. With 25 uniquely delicious flavours spanning Fruits, Desserts, Drinks, and Candy, they offer unrivalled quality and taste without breaking the bank. Your next favourite vape isn't far away; the question is, which of these enticing flavours will take the top spot?
